'''Kelek the Blue''', also known as '''Kelek the Insensate''', was a [[Tefaun]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] who purchased [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], she launched the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] event known as [[the Big Game]], but was eventually forced to sell the station in order to pay back a loan.

==Biography==
The [[Tefaun]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Kelek lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and during her life earned the nicknames Kelek the Blue, and Kelek the Insensate. After [[Skijid Vrescot]], the administrator of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] resort, was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], Kelek purchased the station and made herself the new administrator. During her time as the station's third administrator, the Tefaun expanded the station's facilities and launched [[the Big Game]], a brutal [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competition that was held aboard the Wheel. Despite these additions, the Wheel's revenues fell under Kelek's administration due to a loss of wealthy clientele, who despite initial enjoyment of the Big Game, had been deterred from visiting due to an increasing number of [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]] frequenting the facility. In the hopes that their backing would draw back her patrons, Kelek borrowed money from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]; however, after she became unable to meet her payment schedule, the IBC called in her loan. In order to pay, Kelek was forced to sell her shares in the station to the businessman [[Dominic Raynor]] sometime prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="VSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Kelek earned nicknames describing her as insensate and blue.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kelek was first mentioned in the first part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', and article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] which was published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]].
